sources.title: XINLI1997/DN-MOPD-Qwen3.5-9B-teacher-if · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The Qwen3.5-9B instruction-following (IF) expert used as a frozen teacher in the DN-MOPD paper: Qwen3.5-9B trained with GRPO on instruction-following (IF) prompts.

sources.title: XINLI1997/DN-MOPD-Qwen3.5-4B-baseline-label · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The Label baseline of the DN-MOPD paper at Qwen3.5-4B: multi-teacher on-policy distillation with label routing (each prompt is scored by the expert of its domain, every domain multiplier is 1).

sources.title: DN-MOPD-Qwen3.5-4B-teacher-math - friendli.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-4B's chat template enables thinking by default, so this argument is required. The evaluation settings in the paper were temperature 1.0 and top-p 1.0, with up to 16,384 new tokens (8,192 in the appendix).
